name: Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Holdings Inc.
summary: Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the purchases, sales, bottling, packaging, distribution and marketing of carbonated beverages, coffee beverages, tea beverages, mineral water, and other soft drinks in Japan. The company manufactures and sells food products; operates vending machines; distributes and sells alcoholic products; and manufactures, processes, and sells beverage products and office coffee services.
